hunks.baseline: There are no secrets in modern society.
hunks.sol: There are no absolute secrets in modern society.

hunks.baseline: There are cameras and the internet everywhere, and countless pieces of information spread across the world through them.
hunks.sol: Cameras and the internet are everywhere, carrying countless pieces of information across the world.

hunks.baseline: And sometimes, there are truths that are better left unknown.
hunks.sol: And sometimes, a truth is better left unknown.

hunks.baseline: The screen went black after one last deafening roar, too terrible to be captured in its entirety even by the speakers.
hunks.sol: With one last terrible roar—more than the speakers could fully convey—the screen went black.

hunks.sol: After several seconds of stillness, a single line appeared in the chat. It said enough about everything they had seen and felt over the past half hour.

hunks.baseline: The dragon’s wings as it crossed the skies above Moscow, and Red Square vanishing without a trace.
hunks.sol: A Dragon’s wings crossing the skies above Moscow. Red Square vanishing without a trace.

hunks.baseline: Ironically, the creature had transformed into a human like them, slaughtered the Hunters and soldiers who blocked its way, and strode confidently into the Kremlin.
hunks.sol: The creature taking human form, just like them, then slaughtering the Hunters and soldiers who stood in its way as it strode into the Kremlin.

hunks.baseline: The disaster that engulfed Moscow.
hunks.sol: The calamity that engulfed Moscow.

hunks.baseline: The reverberation carried hundreds, even thousands of kilometers, shaking the world beyond the rectangular screen.
hunks.sol: The rumble traveled hundreds, even thousands of kilometers. It reached far beyond the rectangular screen and shook the world.

hunks.baseline: Countless eyes and ears—and even more cameras—captured the distant flash of light and the enormous mushroom cloud. The footage was immediately compiled into a single video and uploaded to the internet.
hunks.sol: Countless eyes and ears—and even more cameras—caught the distant flash and the enormous mushroom cloud. The footage was quickly compiled into a single video and uploaded to the internet.

hunks.baseline: Its title conveyed the overwhelming despair and shock felt by humanity as the news from Moscow reached them.

hunks.baseline: No one could answer that question.

hunks.baseline: They could only pray with all their hearts.
hunks.sol: All they could do was hope desperately.

hunks.baseline: If God had truly abandoned them, then may someone appear who could save them.
hunks.sol: If God had truly abandoned them, perhaps someone else would appear to save them.

hunks.baseline: May he wake from his deep slumber as soon as possible.
hunks.sol: Perhaps he would wake from his deep sleep as soon as possible.

hunks.baseline: Unlike God, who was so far away that their voices could not reach him, the savior of the new age answered their desperate pleas before long.
hunks.sol: And unlike God, too far away for their voices to reach, the savior of this new age answered their pleas before long.

hunks.baseline: The whole world erupted once more at the first words spoken by the flushed-faced fifty-seventh President of the United States on the holographic TV.
hunks.sol: At those first words from the flushed fifty-seventh President of the United States on the holographic TV, the whole world erupted once more.

hunks.baseline: The modern world meant something special to me.
hunks.sol: The modern world had always meant something special to me.

hunks.baseline: It was the home where I’d been born and raised all my life—a place I could never forget.
hunks.sol: It was where I’d been born and raised. A home I could never forget.

hunks.baseline: Compared to Murim, where danger and trouble lurked around every corner, the modern world let me rest in relative peace.
hunks.sol: Compared to Murim, where danger and trouble lurked around every corner, I could rest here in relative peace.

hunks.baseline: But when had it started?
hunks.sol: But when had that started to change?

hunks.baseline: Everything began to go wrong, like a broken gear.
hunks.sol: Like a broken gear, everything had begun to slip out of place.

hunks.baseline: Would they resist to the bitter end?

hunks.baseline: Or surrender now and save their lives?

hunks.baseline: I murmured the name in my mind as I stared at the holographic screen.

hunks.baseline: The question came to me naturally. I realized my hand had clenched into a fist.
hunks.sol: The question came naturally. Without realizing it, I clenched my fist tighter.

hunks.baseline: A monster without precedent, whose single appearance in the past had sent shock waves around the world.

hunks.baseline: But as his special title, Black Dragon Duke, suggested, Morgoth was no ordinary dragon.
hunks.sol: But as his title, Black Dragon Duke, suggested, Morgoth was no ordinary Dragon.

hunks.baseline: I turned my head and looked at the dozens of holographic screens filling the spacious monitor room, one after another.
hunks.sol: I turned to the dozens of holographic screens filling the spacious monitor room and looked from one to the next.

hunks.sol: A predator brought down a forest of skyscrapers with one flap of its wings, shrugged off a barrage of magic, and trampled Hunters underfoot.

hunks.baseline: Her lower body had already been crushed beyond recognition, and her stomach was split open, her entrails spilling out.
hunks.sol: Her lower body had already been crushed beyond recognition. Her abdomen was split open, her entrails spilling out.

hunks.baseline: But, dazed, she kept drawing her bow at the rear of the retreating allies.
hunks.sol: Still, at the rear of her retreating allies, she drew her bow as if possessed.

hunks.baseline: Until the dragon’s claws rushed in faster than an arrow and took both her arms too.
hunks.sol: She kept drawing until the Dragon’s claws came at her faster than an arrow and took both her arms.

hunks.baseline: Blood spurted along with the severed flesh.
hunks.sol: Blood spurted from the torn flesh.

hunks.baseline: A deep shadow fell across the woman’s face, twisted with unbearable pain.
hunks.sol: A deep shadow fell across her face, twisted with unbearable pain.

hunks.baseline: The Black Dragon’s question rang down from high above. The woman spat blood and answered.
hunks.sol: The Black Dragon’s question rang down from high above. She spat up bloody phlegm and answered.

hunks.baseline: “Because we were taught this is courage. Not foolishness.”
hunks.sol: “Because we were taught to call this courage. Not foolishness.”

hunks.baseline: “Good. Then, brave human, will you still follow me?”
hunks.sol: “Good. Then, brave human, would you follow me even now?”

hunks.baseline: The woman grinned, baring her blood-soaked teeth.
hunks.sol: She grinned, baring her blood-soaked teeth.

hunks.baseline: “My name is Pie Chen. I’m not just some human. I’m Pie Chen.”
hunks.sol: “My name is Pie Chen. Not just *human*. Pie Chen.”

hunks.baseline: “You’d better. Soon, some amazing guy’s gonna come looking for you and ask about that name. Ask about my name, my—”
hunks.sol: “You’d better. Soon, someone incredible is going to come looking for you and ask about that name. Ask about… the name…”

hunks.baseline: Her voice faded, and her panting stopped.
hunks.sol: Her voice faded. Then her ragged breathing stopped.

hunks.baseline: She was an S-rank Hunter Hong Kong was proud of, a hero of the last Great Cataclysm, and my friend.
hunks.sol: Hong Kong’s pride. An S-rank Hunter, a hero of the last Great Cataclysm, and my friend.

hunks.baseline: She’d died a week ago.
hunks.sol: She had died a week ago.

hunks.baseline: The memory surfaced without warning.
hunks.sol: The memory came back to me.

hunks.sol: *Today’s the kind of day you drink.*

hunks.baseline: “Huh?”

hunks.baseline: “It might be our last chance.”
hunks.sol: *It might be our last chance.*

hunks.baseline: Never once thinking it really might be our last drink together.
hunks.sol: Neither of us thought it really would be our last drink together.

hunks.baseline: A voice suddenly broke into my thoughts.
hunks.sol: A voice broke into my thoughts.

hunks.baseline: It was rough and gravelly, a little different from Magic Johnson’s deep voice.
hunks.sol: Rough and gravelly, it was different from Magic Johnson’s deep voice.

hunks.baseline: I didn’t ask who the unexpected visitor was.

hunks.sol: The acrid smell of cigar smoke had slipped in before the monitor room door even opened, telling me who it was.

hunks.sol: “Her sacrifice saved a lot of lives. Including one bastard who came back alive in disgrace.”

hunks.sol: “As soon as I woke up, I thought I should’ve died instead of Pie Chen.”

hunks.baseline: Chuck Hagel blew out a cloud of cigar smoke and gave a bitter smile.
He looked at the familiar faces and the deaths playing over and over on the dozens of holographic screens.

hunks.baseline: “I swore I’d never let something like that happen again… And now look.”

hunks.baseline: All of it weighed on my heart, heavier than I could bear.
hunks.sol: The weight of it all pressed down on my chest, more than I could bear.

hunks.baseline: Reason and emotion tangled together, and then my mind turned cold.
hunks.sol: Reason and emotion tangled together. Then my mind went cold.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, Pie Chen died again before my eyes.
hunks.sol: Before my eyes, Pie Chen died once more.

hunks.baseline: At her, using what little breath she had left to warn Morgoth that someone was coming for him.
hunks.sol: At her warning Morgoth, with what little breath she had left, that someone was coming for him.
